r1-handoff.title: Handoff compliance
r1-handoff.imperative: Did the change do what the handoff asked, within its allowed scope? Record pass/fail with a finding.
r1-handoff.finding: BLOCKER: The handoff requires that sector-loop anchor positions (s1, s2, s3) are CO-ESTIMATED FREE PARAMETERS with reported uncertainty. The implementation claims to co-estimate all three, but s3_est is unpacked from x[2] on line 130 of sector_anchor.py yet NEVER referenced in the residuals computation (_build_residuals_fn). The s3 sector residual is (t_end - t_s2) - off['s3'], which depends only on s2_est and the actual last sample time -- s3_est has zero gradient. Confirmed experimentally: when s3_true=3000m and x0[2]=4250m (initial guess), the optimizer leaves s3_fit=4250m because it has no gradient to move it. The fitted s3 in fitted_anchors_m is effectively the initial guess (0.85 * lap_length_m), not a co-estimated calibration parameter. This violates the core constraint 'anchors-are-calibration-parameters'. Furthermore, the known-answer recovery test (test_sector_anchor_recovers_anchor_positions) uses known_anchors[3] = 0.85*5000=4250m, which exactly matches x0[2]=0.85*5000=4250m -- so the test always passes trivially for s3 regardless of whether s3 is being estimated. The test is tautological for s3.

r3-evidence.title: Required evidence
r3-evidence.imperative: Is the required evidence present and does it actually demonstrate the behavior? Record pass/fail with a finding.
r3-evidence.finding: Evidence partially demonstrates behavior but contains a masked gap. (1) 'py -m pytest tests/unit/preprocessing/test_trajectory_grading.py -q' independently confirmed: 47 passed in 0.30s. (2) 'py -m src.utils.simplification_limits --paths ...' independently confirmed: PASS 7 files. (3) However, the claimed L1 known-answer recovery for s3 is spurious: the test uses known_anchors[3]=0.85*lap_length_m, which equals the optimizer initial guess x0[2]=0.85*lap_length_m. The test cannot detect that s3 is not being estimated (confirmed by running with s3_true=3000 vs initial=4250 -- s3_fit remains 4250). The evidence bundle does not actually demonstrate that s3 is recovered as a co-estimated free parameter.
